name: Shopify
description: Shopify is a commerce platform for running online and in-person stores. Businesses use it to manage products, sales channels, storefronts, orders, customers, payments, fulfilment, and related operations.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Shopify shop, then let agents inspect bounded shop and product data, prepare product changes, create or update drafts, and separately activate or publish an explicitly reviewed product under Safe or Dangerous policy. Relay limits V1 to the product catalogue and explicit publications; orders, customers, payments, fulfilment, inventory and pricing writes, destructive lifecycle operations, themes, files, discounts, billing, administration, bulk operations, and arbitrary GraphQL remain unavailable.

providerSetup.blocker: The Relay Console public Shopify app, client credentials, compliance webhooks, distribution review, and a development-store authorization are not available in this worker's headless environment.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the public Shopify app, register the exact Relay callback and mandatory privacy webhooks, request only write_products and write_publications, store the client credentials in the staging secret variables, authorize a development shop, verify rotating expiring offline tokens and all nine V1 actions, then submit the app for Shopify review.

evidence.supports: Public distribution is the Shopify model for an app that can authorize multiple stores and requires Shopify review before App Store distribution.
Non-embedded authorization code grants redirect through the shop admin, bind a state nonce and exact redirect URI, and exchange the returned code for an access token.
New public apps use expiring offline access tokens and rotating refresh tokens; access tokens last 60 minutes and refresh tokens rotate with a 90-day lifetime.
Publishing a product to an explicit publication uses publishablePublish, requires write_publications, and the product must be active to be visible.
Public apps must subscribe to Shopify's mandatory privacy compliance webhooks and validate their HMAC signatures.
Shopify App Store distribution requires an app listing, review submission, automated checks, and manual review before approval.
